disease_label: Congenital variant Rett syndrome (atypical Rett syndrome); 14q12 microdeletion Rett syndrome-like phenotype
source_title: 14q12 microdeletions excluding FOXG1 give rise to a congenital variant Rett syndrome-like phenotype

variants.variant_type: interstitial deletion 14q12 (1.17 Mb, 28.765-29.942 Mb, HG18; includes PRKD1, FOXG1 intact) - Case 1
interstitial deletion 14q12 (1.15 Mb, 28.407-29.558 Mb, HG18; includes PRKD1, FOXG1 ~0.1 Mb outside) - Case 2
interstitial deletion 14q12 (0.89 Mb, 28.499-29.386 Mb, HG18; includes part of PRKD1, FOXG1 ~0.18 Mb outside) - Case 3

expected_evidence.value: Congenital variant Rett syndrome (atypical Rett syndrome); 14q12 microdeletion Rett syndrome-like phenotype

expected_evidence.value: severe to profound intellectual impairment; early-onset developmental delay without regression; postnatal microcephaly; truncal hypotonia with limb hypertonia; seizure disorder (infantile spasms; tonic-clonic); agenesis of the corpus callosum; subtle facial dysmorphism; hand stereotypies (midline hand grasping, wringing, tapping, mouthing); inability to walk; absent or minimal speech; feeding difficulties / poor hand function; bruxism; constipation; disturbed sleep pattern; cold extremities; tongue thrusting / protruding tongue; strabismus (esotropia); abnormal breathing pattern (hyperventilation, deep breathing, sleep-disordered breathing/apnea); scoliosis; spastic quadriparesis (Case 1); reduced bone mineral density (Case 1)
2 female (Cases 1, 2), 1 male (Case 3); FOXG1 c.256dupC patient (Patient 4) female
congenital / early infantile (hypotonia from birth; developmental delay evident in first months)
de novo (Case 2 microdeletion confirmed de novo; Cases 1 and 3 parental studies normal; FOXG1 c.256dupC confirmed de novo in Patient 4)
